landmarks.what: grants/grant_services/grant_clients schema with partial live index; CreateGrant overlap-checked in one tx; CAS SetGrantStatus is the only exit from active
Add/RemoveBlockedServices edit the live list under the RMW mutex as set-union/difference and skip the POST when nothing changes; fake gains BlockedServices/RemoveClient/CountRequests

Engine owns every grant AdGuard write under one mutex with one ApplyTimeout ctx per operation: Create unblocks stored clients (partial apply reported, never rolled back), timer expiry re-blocks by set-union and CASes to expired, Extend reschedules, End reverts now

one pass under mu reads AdGuard once, reverts overdue grants, removes re-blocked granted ids per drifted client, re-arms missing timers; Start runs it before listen, Run loops on an injectable interval

/api/v1/grants GET/POST plus {id}/extend and {id}/end behind the session gate: 422 duration/service validation before the 404 child lookup before any AdGuard call, 409 with grant_id on overlap, 201 {id, ends_at, applied, failed}, 502 naming clients on a failed end revert

main builds the grant engine after store.Open, runs its startup pass under a 30 s bound before net.Listen (error logged, never fatal), wires Grants into api.Deps and loops eng.Run on reconcileInterval (60 s, test-overridable) beside the prober and sweeper
